caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a metal teapot or coffee pot. The pot is rendered in shades of black, grey, and silver, giving it a reflective metallic appearance. It has a bulbous body with a wide base, a long, narrow, curved spout on the left, and a high, elegantly curved handle on the right, which appears to have a slightly lighter, worn look compared to the body. The vessel is topped with a domed, tiered lid featuring a small finial at the top. Double horizontal bands encircle both the upper and midsection of the body. The background is plain and beige, and beneath the pot, centered text reads “APPROXIMATELY 1/2 SIZE” in uppercase black letters. The entire composition focuses on the pot without any additional context or background elements.
title: Coffee Pot
